messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered - service=model-catalog, severity=high. Alert: catalog promotion created with inconsistent tokenizer metadata. Root reason: downstream tokenizer mismatch causing embed/encode failures. PD incident id=PD-88122
Ajay K: acked PD-88122. I'm on it, will take a look at the catalog promotion history and routing table.
Maria C: seeing increased 500s on /v1/embeddings since the promotion window (around 3370012300). Traffic surge + tokenizer errors in logs. Pushing to channel.
Ajay K: grabbing logs from catalog service now. quick grep shows: ERROR model_resolver: tokenizer 'cl100k_base' != catalog.tokenizer 'bpe-legacy' for model rev "rev-2026-03-15-09"
eng-runtime-bot: kube-event catalog-deploy rev-2026-03-15-09 -> pods failing liveness check (OOM not enough mem for tokenizer init).
Lexi P: Customer impact: internal dashboard shows embedding error rate jumped from 0.02% -> 1.8% and latency p95 doubled for some tenants. No large data loss reported but degraded responses for several enterprise accounts. CS notified.
Samir R: quick mitigation option: pin model route back to previous revision (rev-2026-03-14-21) while we fix catalog metadata. I can run route pin now if Ajay agrees.
Ajay K: yes pin it. command: ```
# pin route to previous revision
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/v1/routes/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"models/embedding-prod","revision":"rev-2026-03-14-21"}'
```
Maria C: after pin we should also disable autopromote for the catalog job until we confirm tokenizer compatibility.
Ajay K: pin in progress... "route pinned". rolling traffic back to rev-2026-03-14-21. monitoring metrics.
eng-runtime-bot: rollout complete -> new route active rev-2026-03-14-21. health checks passing.
Lexi P: p95 latency back to baseline, error rate dropping to ~0.1%. Not fully resolved for all tenants, but major regression mitigated.
Samir R: root cause: the promotion job published an older tokenizer tag (bpe-legacy) for that model family after a metadata merge conflict in the publishing pipeline. Patch ready to update tokenizer field in catalog to cl100k_base. Example patch: ```
PATCH /v1/catalog/models/rev-2026-03-15-09
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tokenizer": "cl100k_base",
  "notes": "fix: correct tokenizer after merge conflict"
}
```
Ajay K: go ahead Samir. let's also add a safety check to the publisher so future promotions validate tokenizer compatibility with runtime-shared manifest.
Samir R: applying patch now.```
kubectl exec -it catalog-publisher -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:8080/v1/models/rev-2026-03-15-09 -d '{\"tokenizer\":\"cl100k_base\"}'"
```
eng-runtime-bot: catalog service restarted config watcher -> picked up new tokenizer metadata.
Maria C: monitoring. embedding errors trending down to baseline over last 6 minutes.
Ajay K: closing PD condition: will leave ticket open for postmortem. assign to eng-runtime + publishing pipeline to add validator.
SRE Lead: stepping in for handoff. Thanks Ajay and Samir — I'll own the postmortem and action items. Please file a short incident note with timeline and the exact publisher commit that introduced the bad metadata.
Lexi P: CS: queued customer communications for impacted tenants with summary + mitigation steps.
Ajay K: filing quick incident note now and adding links to logs and the patch command. handing off to SRE Lead for follow-up. I'll be reachable if anything regresses. :white_check_mark: 
IncidentBot: PD-88122 marked resolved by Ajay K. Escalation window closed.
SRE Lead: will schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow and add a pre-publish validator to the pipeline (tokenizer schema + runtime compatibility check). tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.
Maria C: thanks team. leaving monitoring on for next hour then will drop to normal.
Ajay K: thumbs up.
